title: The Bottleneck That Controls the System
short_teaser: In a process, improving every step may not increase the final result if one constrained step still limits the flow.
story: In a process, improving every step may not increase the final result if one constrained step still limits the flow. Finding the bottleneck helps effort go where it can change the whole system. The busiest-looking problem is not always the limiting problem. Strategy is the discipline of choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: The busiest-looking problem is not always the limiting problem. Strategy is the discipline of choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change.
spark_application: Identify the decision underneath your current activity. Choose the smallest next move that would create useful information. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
